packageRules.description: Ship every update once CI has proved it, majors included. CI builds and smoke-tests the image on pull requests, so "it compiles and starts" is checked before merge rather than after.

grafana-foundation-sdk versions are <build-epoch>!<grafana-minor>, and within one publishing wave the epoch rises as the minor falls — so the highest version on offer is the oldest schema. Majors automerge here, so pin the minor and let only the build epoch advance.
Keep unrelated updates independently attributable and reversible.
